 Shem Mem-Beis (42) = three times yad = Shem Ehyeh + Shem Yikov = 370 lights [cross-references from Sections 10, 11].

 Shem Mah (45) = gematria of Adam [cross-reference from Section 1].

 Shem Sa'el (סא"ל) — first letters of א׳תה ס׳תר ל׳י and of ס׳וף א׳דם ל׳מות [cross-references from Sections 1, 15].

 Shem Samech-Gimel (63) = the opposite of gas ruach (arrogance); emerges from Havayah in full spelling with Yuds; its full spelling = bechiyah (weeping); together with the 10 letters of Havayah = Yom Tov [cross-references from Sections 2, 3, 5, 8, 10].

 Shem Kamah (קמ"ה = 145) — the Name of Yosef's sheaf ("And behold, it arose"); first letters of ה׳שקיפה מ׳מעון ק׳דשך; emerges from the verse about kings rising and falling [cross-references from Sections 6, 12, 13].

 Shem Kuf-Samech-Alef (161) = letters alef-samech-kuf; emerges from Ehyeh in full spelling [cross-references from Sections 1, 7, 10].

 ש'רה א'סתר ב'ת י'הודית ו'י מתה
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of the names of the five holy women who died — Sarah, Esther, the daughter of Yehudis, and others — spell מתה ויבאש ("she died and became foul"). [Cross-reference from Section 13.] This entry appears at the end of a story in Sipuray Maasios.
 
 Sichos after Sipuray Maasios

 ש'שים ר'בוא ב'כרס א'חד — בשרא
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "sixty myriads in one belly" spell בשרא (bisra, "flesh"). [Cross-reference from Section 2.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:1; 2

 § 22
 Tav — The Letter Tav
 ת

ת

TAV — Numerical Value: 400 | The last letter — the seal of truth | 51 source entries

Hebrew EntryEnglish Translation & ExplanationSource

 ת׳ — סגול + חיריק
 
 Gematria (×2)

 The letter Tav (ת = 400) yields two gematria connections from the same lesson:

 (1) = the segol of the Name קס"א [161] together with the chirik of the Name ס"ג [63] (combined = 400 via a specific calculation);

 (2) = peshutah (simple form) — the plain value of 400.

 [Cross-references from Sections 15, 17.] The last letter, in its simplest form, contains the deepest gematria of the vowel-signs.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 6:7

 ת׳ = נון + חית
 
 Shape / Form

 The letter Tav is formed when a Nun and a Ches are joined together. [Cross-reference from Section 14.] The final letter of the alphabet is composed of the 14th (Nun) and 8th (Ches) letters — the letter of the fifty gates and the letter of transcendence.
 
 Likutay Mooharan 1

 ת'אות ר'שעים ת'אבד — תר"ת
 
 Roshay Saveivos

 The first letters of "the desire of the wicked shall perish" (ת׳אות ר׳שעים ת׳אבד) [Psalms 112:10] spell תר"ת — the acronym of the three shofar sounds: Tekiah, Shevarim, Teruah (ת׳קיעה ש׳ברים ת׳רועה). The perishing of the wicked's desire is encoded in the shofar call.
 
 
 Likutay Mooharan II:88; Sichos HaRan 180

 תבל — תיו לב / ב' פעמים ריו
 
 Multiple

 Tevel (תבל, "the inhabited world / the earth") yields two connections:

 (1) Tziroof Its letters = ת לב (Tav-Lamed-Beis = Tav + "heart") — the world is the heart of the Tav;

 (2) Gematria Tevel = Reish-Yud-Vov (ריו = 216) twice (432 = 400+30+2). [Cross-reference from Section 20.]
 
 Likutay Mooharan 5:5; 46

 תגי דל — יתגדל
 
 Tziroof

 Tagei Dal (תגי דל, "crowns of the poor / the tagin of the Dalet") — its letters are contained in יתגדל (Yisgadal — the opening of Kaddish).
